procedural_matters: The panel of the international Jury was composed according to RRS N 1.4(b)
BRA 57305 was represented by Joana Freitas.
FRA 57530 was represented by Julliette Peyre.
Joaquim Malhao, coach of BRA 57305, attended the hearing as an observer.
Melisa Paradeda, helm of BRA 55511, gave evidence as a withness.
facts: The wind at the time of the incident was 13 knots.
BRA 57305 rounded mark 3p clear ahead of FRA 57530.
Five boat lengths after rounding the mark and while heading for the finishing line, FRA 57530 established an overlap one and a half metres to windward of BRA 57305.
BRA 57305 luffed smoothly and FRA 57530 luffed and avoided contact.
conclusions: FRA 57530 to windward kept clear of BRA 57305 to leeward, as required by RRS 11.
